text:
maria: Quick non-work poll: if your debugging style were a snack, what would it be? Short answers only. I'll start: 'dark chocolate' 
(slow, focused, appreciated after a lot of work)
samir: popcorn 
(light, lots of tiny steps, gets louder the longer you stare at logs) :popcorn:
nina: gummy bears 
(cheery, sometimes sticky but gets the job done) :bear:
harry: instant ramen 
(cheap, comforting, late-night emergency fix) :ramen:
jade: instant espresso shots 
(blunt force caffeine, risky but effective) :coffee:
aldo: mixed nuts 
(varied approach, lots of experiments, you never know what you'll find) :peanuts:
ops-bot: Friendly reminder: no actual food at desks during on-call shifts per policy (kidding, but keep keyboards safe) :robot_face:
maria: Love these. Quick follow-ups: 1) drop one emoji representing your pick, 2) anyone want to expand to a 1-line metaphor?
samir: :popcorn: "spam the console until something pops"
nina: :bear: "treat tiny failures like gummy bits: chew them until they smooth out"
harry: :ramen: "when in doubt, warm it up and revisit in the morning"
jade: :coffee: "inject focus, pray for reproducibility"
aldo: :peanuts: "shake the jar and see what falls out"
maria: Thanks team. Note for ops: if we ever do swag, could be a sticker series: 'debug snacks' :sticker:
ops-bot: FYI: swag requests go through ops for budget sign-off. Ping @ops for feasibility.
maria: Awesome. This made my Monday. Whoever wants to turn their line into a tiny sticker design, tag me and I'll send it to #design-requests. :party:
